items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Thursday, 17 September 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Sunny spells and only isolated showers today, but rather breezy with fresh to strong westerly winds. Maximum temperature 16°C.

Dry tonight, but rain will develop late tomorrow morning, becoming persistent and quite heavy for a time before turning light and patchy by evening. Strong southwest winds tomorrow, with temperatures around 16°C.


##Outlook##

A mostly dry weekend, with some sunny intervals at times. Still rather breezy on Saturday with strong westerlies, then easing winds on Sunday.
